Recommended experiences

Tours around Arenal Volcano

Tours selected for quality, safety and local guides. Book direct and secure your spot.

See all tours →
3 hours

White Water Rafting II-III

Rafting on the Sarapiqui River with Class II-III rapids, ideal for families and those seeking moderate excitement in a natural setting, with expert guides, tropical fruit, and a traditional Costa Rican lunch.

From $95 USD

View tour Book
3 hours

Horseback Riding to Arenal Volcano

Ride through rainforest, rivers and lava fields on Costa Rica's best-trained horses. This adventure takes place on a private ranch surrounded by primary and secondary rainforest near Arenal Volcano National Park, offering breathtaking views of canyon, old lava flows and lush jungle. With well-trained and gentle horses, you'll cross rivers and forest trails while spotting monkeys, hawks, toucans and wildlife. Bilingual nature guides share insights about ecosystems and local fauna. After the ride, relax at Montaña de Fuego hot springs with 3 hot pools and 2 cold pools. Perfect for families, couples, and nature lovers seeking an authentic and memorable experience.

From $65 USD

View tour Book
2 hours

Canopy Los Cañones

Fly above the rainforest in Arenal's most thrilling zipline adventure. Canopy Los Cañones is one of La Fortuna's most complete and exhilarating rainforest adventures. With 12 cables and 13 platforms covering 2.8 km, experience the thrill of soaring between giant trees, deep ravines and lush vegetation. Encounter howler monkeys, toucans, sloths, coatis and exotic birds. After the zipline course, enjoy free access to hot and cold pools, crocodile farms and a butterfly garden.

From $125 USD

We are Afortunados

15+ years showing La Fortuna the way locals live it

We started as a small Facebook page offering local stays and tours. Today we are a Costa Rican team with our own hotels and villas, and agreements with the best parks and tour operators.

Our own stays
Hotels and villas designed for comfort and a real connection with nature.

Read our story

We have our own vacation homes, carefully designed to provide comfort, warmth and a genuine connection with nature. Our agreements with parks and the best tour operators in the country let us offer the best prices and close support so you can fully enjoy each destination.

What truly sets us apart is our multidisciplinary team, with extensive experience in hospitality, gastronomy, sales, tour operations and personalized attention. We believe responsibility and care in every detail make the difference.

We don't just sell tourism services: we share experiences filled with family warmth, peace of mind and trust. Our mission is to be the leading platform to discover Costa Rica in an authentic, safe and personal way, full of Costa Rican hospitality.

Frequently asked questions

Before you book

Have another question?

Ask us on WhatsApp →
How do I book? +

Message us on WhatsApp at +506 8459 7077 and we'll help you quote your stay and tours. You can also book online from each hotel's page.

Where are you located? +

In La Fortuna de San Carlos, Alajuela, Costa Rica, close to Arenal Volcano.

Is hot springs access included? +

Yes. When you stay with us, a day pass to the Hotel Sueño Dorado hot springs is included.

Is breakfast included? +

At Hotel Sueño Dorado, yes: a buffet breakfast is included. For our other stays we'll confirm on WhatsApp depending on the option you choose.

Can you arrange tours and transfers? +

Yes. We coordinate tours with verified operators and local guides, and help you with schedules and transfers.

Is there WiFi and parking? +

Hotel Sueño Dorado has fiber-optic WiFi and private parking. Ask us about the other options.
